shortDescription: Pakistan has raised $3 billion through a dual-tranche Eurobond sale that drew nearly $6 billion in orders, its finance ministry said on Thursday.It raised $1.75 billion through a 5.5-year bond at a coupon rate of 7.5% and $1.25 billion through a 10-year bond at 7.9%, the ministry said.

children: Pakistan has raised $3 billion through a dual-tranche Eurobond sale that drew nearly $6 billion in orders, its finance ministry said on Thursday.
It raised $1.75 billion through a 5.5-year bond at a coupon rate of 7.5% and $1.25 billion through a 10-year bond at 7.9%, the ministry said.
